description: This source file provides utility classes and functions for routing and managing search API calls within the LiteLLM project. It handles search tool updating, matching, load balancing, fallbacks, and error handling, enabling flexible and robust search integrations.

classes.name: SearchAPIRouter
classes.description: A static utility class that provides methods for managing search API routing, including updating search tools, matching tools by name, and executing search requests with load balancing and fallback mechanisms.

methods.description: Selects a specific search tool based on name, applies load balancing via random choice, and executes the search provider's API call.
